english.title: Destroy / deface / alter an equine ID
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[destroyed or defaced an equine ID]_
(B)_[alters an entry in an ID]_
(C)_[without the written authority of an inspector, defaced, obliterated or removed a mark applied under regulation 33 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019]_

otherwise than in accordance with any entitlement, obligation or requirement to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 26 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
otherwise than in accordance with any entitlement / obligation / requirement in the regulations
destroyed / defaced an equine ID OR
altered an entry in an equine ID OR
defaced / obliterated / removed a mark applied under regulation 33 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019 (except under written authority of an inspector)

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant

(A)_[destroyed or defaced an equine ID]_
(B)_[alters an entry in an ID]_
(C)_[without the written authority of an inspector, defaced, obliterated or removed a mark applied under regulation 33 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019]_

otherwise than in accordance with any entitlement, obligation or requirement to do so.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
